QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Child of Destiny
QuestInfo.0: Ask Perzen about a way to cure Crawls with Balrog.
QuestInfo.1: Perzen asked you to bring some ingredients for making medicine.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the ingredients to Perzen. Will the medicine it cure Crawls with Balrog?

0.0: I do know a way to neutralize the poison, but I will need some help. You will help me, will you not?\r\n#L0##bOf course! What can I do? And...can we afford to make Crawls with Balrog wait?#l\n#k
0.1: Relax...Crawls with Balrog will not die this day. It is not his destiny.\r\n#L0##bHuh? Destiny?#l\n#k
0.2: Crawls with Balrog has a great future ahead of him. A little thing like a fever will not interfere with that.\r\n#L0##bHow could you know about the future, unless... Are you from the future too?!#l\n#k
0.3: Heh... I can't tell you that. I can only say that each of us has a destiny laid before us. Now, we have to get little Crawls with Balrog healed up, don't we? I'll need some ingredients to make the medicine. Could you bring them to me?

yes.0: Sometimes, one poison can neutralize another. Please eliminate Mossy Mushrooms and bring me #b#e40 #t4000437##n#k items. You should be find a lot of Mossy Mushrooms at #m300020200# or #m300020210#.

no.0: Looks like mushroom poison was the cause. We'll need an antidote to cure him, and I'll need your help to make it.

1.0: Did you gather the antidote ingredients?

yes.0: Good job, but I'll have to save these for another time. Crawls with Balrog beat out the fever on his own! If you are still worried about him, go see for yourself.

item.0: You haven't found the #bBlack Mushroom Spores#k yet? I need 40 of them for a potent enough antidote! You can find many Mossy Mushrooms at #m300020200# and #m300020210#.
